selection_rule:
Prepare reproducible integer-abundance empirical populations, without fitting.

The selection rule is fixed before estimator experiments: among groups with at
least 20 identified species, take the six largest N and the two central ranks
of the remaining groups sorted by N (ties broken by the group key).
These are finite empirical distributions, not estimates of wild abundance.
scope: Empirical abundance distributions; no inference about true unobserved ecological species richness.

datasets.grouping_rule: state x year x sampling_method_simple; all available years
datasets.notes: One retained row = one recorded fish, including rows expanded from aggregate catch. Map local taxon list to binomial names; merge aliases; exclude missing/coarse/hybrid taxa and either no-catch flag. Groups pool lakes within state and gear, defining an empirical catch distribution, not wild population abundance.

datasets.grouping_rule: pool x year(sdate) x gear; years >= 1993 (post design revision)
datasets.notes: Sum catch only, never repeated sheet or collection totals. Use documented species-code whitelist; remove unidentified, no-fish, hybrid and unlisted codes. The latter includes valid but undocumented additions: the filtered subset is explicitly narrower than the complete release.

datasets.grouping_rule: program x marine ecoregion x survey year; method 1 only
datasets.notes: Sum integer total across legitimate size-class and survey/block rows. Exclude non-binomial unidentified/hybrid labels. Count unit is fish sightings recorded by underwater visual surveys; repeated observation of individual fish across surveys cannot be excluded; no biomass or density values used.

datasets.grouping_rule: NRSA two-year survey cycle x source ecoregion; VISIT_NO=1; IS_DISTINCT=1
datasets.notes: Integer FINAL_CT/TOTAL only. Join pinned NRSA taxon list, retain fish with species-level binomials, merge subspecies/age categories, exclude HERP, hybrids, unresolved taxa. First visit only; pooled site catches represent an empirical distribution, not survey-weighted regional abundance.

datasets.grouping_rule: single route survey (RouteDataID), limited a priori to years 2015-2025; RPID=101 standard runs
datasets.notes: SpeciesTotal is a bird observation count, not StopTotal (occupied stops). Only States.zip used: 50-StopData is an overlapping representation. Map AOU through supplied SpeciesList, merge forms/subspecies, remove hybrid/unidentified labels. Sightings do not guarantee distinct individual birds; empirical count-distribution benchmark only.

excluded_sources.ebird: Downloaded tutorial is a single focal species; full EBD unavailable.
excluded_sources.amazonfish_ictio: Occurrence records not exchangeable fish individual counts.
excluded_sources.midfish_cpue: Abundance_Data_Files contains CPUE products, not raw counts.
excluded_sources.yrfir_edna: Barcode/sequence counts are not animal individual counts.
excluded_sources.biotime_rivfishtime_fishglob: Not used in this fixed five-source benchmark; unit harmonization and additional loaders required.
